description: Read current managed database size, memory, region and compute state without running SQL or waking the database. Shared Dev/Prod resolves to one physical database. A null database means no confirmed managed placement. suspend_timeout_seconds=0 uses the provider default; -1 disables scale to zero. A configured value is not proof that an in-progress resize finished. This read never resizes or changes billing.

profile_name.description: Saved login to act as (profile_list shows them). Needed only when several logins could run this call; OHMYHOST_PROFILE of this server must match it.
